displayPattern: PCBHR104 unitary diagnostic display in Goodman service manual RS6200007 r27 (ASXC, DSXC, GSXC condensing units and ASZC, DSZC, GSZC heat pumps). Digit 3 is blank. Digit 2 is d and digit 1 is 1. The code is d1
meaning: Invalid data on the network. The air conditioner or heat pump fails to operate.
causes: The unit is wired as a communicating system and the integrated control module contains invalid shared data, or the network data is invalid for that module
diySteps: Write down d1. It is not d0 (no shared data) and not d2 (system mismatch)
Technician: verify communicating or legacy wiring, populate the correct shared data with Bluetooth Shared Data Loader BTSDL01, or wire the system as a legacy system
Technician: turn power off before the repair, insert the loader before power is turned on, and turn power off before the loader is removed
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. d1 means the shared data or network data was rejected as invalid.
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
